# hush_pinot_access_privilege (Resource)

Manage Pinot access privileges in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Pinot access privilege: queries on two tables through the broker
resource "hush_pinot_access_privilege" "example" {
  name        = "query-orders"
  description = "Query the orders tables"

  grant {
    tables = ["orders", "order_items"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grant` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The tables the generated user can query through the Pinot broker. It gets no controller access. An empty grant means all tables (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grant))
- `name` (String) The name of the Pinot access privilege

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Pinot access privilege

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Pinot access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege

<a id="nestedblock--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Optional:

- `exclude_tables` (List of String) The tables denied, even when `tables` is omitted, named without their `_OFFLINE`/`_REALTIME` suffix. Needs Pinot 1.4.0 or later: an older Pinot would ignore it and grant every table, so the policy fails there. An empty list is refused
- `tables` (List of String) The tables granted, named without their `_OFFLINE`/`_REALTIME` suffix. Omit for all tables; an empty list is refused, since Pinot reads it as all tables too
